response.sql: WITH race_avg AS (SELECT c.country, ds.raceId, AVG(ds.wins) AS race_wins FROM driverStandings ds JOIN races r ON r.raceId = ds.raceId JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY c.country, ds.raceId), country_avg AS (SELECT country, AVG(race_wins) AS avg_wins FROM race_avg GROUP BY country), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS overall_avg FROM country_avg), above AS (SELECT ca.country, ca.avg_wins FROM country_avg ca, overall o WHERE ca.avg_wins > o.overall_avg), group_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS group_avg FROM above) SELECT a.country, a.avg_wins, a.avg_wins - o.overall_avg AS diff_from_overall_avg, a.avg_wins - g.group_avg AS diff_from_group_avg FROM above a, overall o, group_avg g WHERE a.avg_wins > g.group_avg ORDER BY a.avg_wins DESC;
